title: Business Office Calculation of the CEP Refund Amount on an Active School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The CEP refund amount on an active School Nutrition Services Meal Account at a CEP campus is the account's whole balance, with nothing kept and no deposit held back.

The account's balance for the CEP refund is its deposits, voids and transfers in less its purchases, refunds, transfers out and returned deposits, as they stand when the CEP refund is made.

The amount is put together in this order: first every amount kept is added together, which gives the keep; then the keep and every deposit held back are subtracted from the account's balance. The CEP refund amount is that result, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; when it is below the refund minimum no CEP refund is made. With nothing kept and nothing held back, the amount is the balance itself.

The refund minimum is the one in the refund terms (5.00).

## Hypothetical balances

| Account's balance | CEP refund amount |
|---|---|
| 38.45 | 38.45 |
| 5.00 | 5.00 |
| 4.80 | below the refund minimum: no CEP refund is made |
| 1.65 below zero | no CEP refund is made |
